notes.title: Bug Fixes (Upcoming)
notes.content:

notes.title: Release Date Delay
notes.content:
[h1]Release Date Update[/h1][p]Unfortunately, I need to delay the full game release due to several different factors! I really don't want to rush, and to be honest, its extremely tight to get everything finished until September 30! I don't have a new date yet, but expect it around October/November at earliest! 
[/p][p]I'm really sorry for this, but think that if I push and crunch the game to get it out in the end of September, there will be a lot of issues, since theres still some bugs to sort out, some steps left in performance optimization, and I tend to want to iterate the puzzles based on player feedback. 
[/p][p]Without the extra time, I would need to very quickly throw together the last couple of puzzles, and I don't want the last puzzles to feel lazy, to easy, unclear etc. Once again I'm a solo dev, with some collaborators, but I'm the only permanent team member! 
[/p][p]However, we will try to release a NEW UPDATED demo before this, with the new recorded dialogue[/p][p]I hope you understand [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504228/cef79ffeb37a715ff9b9facd38839c432076f81b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Demo - Patch 1 Notes[/h1]

The first demo patch has just been released! There wont be many patches of the demo, instead we will focus on patching alot after the full game relerase in September.

However, there still were some bugs, issues and performance optimizations that we wanted to make for the demo!
--------------------------------------------------
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where “Continue” (Load Game) didn’t work in the title screen
[*]Fixed a bug where audio volume and mouse sensitivity settings didn’t persist between levels and opening the game again after quitting
[*]Fixed a bug where some invalid objects could be used on pressure plates
[*]Fixed a bug where you could jump so that the camera clipped outside roofs and walls
[*]Fixed a bug where absorb sometimes stopped working after crossing checkpoint triggers
[*]Fixed some more bugs with the force field mechanic
[*]Fixed a bug with the ice obstacle object
[*]Fixed some issues with the lightning system which resulted in shadows not being rendered
[*]Tweaked and improved lightning system, implemented ambient occlusion, color grading and post processing
[*]Game can now be paused even during cutscenes
[*]Some puzzles have been tweaked or changed to enhance clarity and to failsafe softlocks
[*]More environment details, models, textures and effects added
[*]"VSync" option added to the options menu
[*]Cleaned up the options UI layout, to make it more clear
[*]Jump air control and physics tweaked
[*]Pickup position is now centered

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504228/47f7a0ea094ed434d47ae7d1042ecbe35a15d7aa.png[/img]

notes.title: DEMO RELEASED
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504228/f1db15b971982e49e74ea4631f2895bb5d607679.png[/img]

Finally, the DEMO of One More Experiment is out! What a feeling, my first STEAM release ever!

DOWNLOAD IT NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3508790/One_More_Experiment/

Full game is coming in SEPTEMBER!

It's been quite a journey, it's been overwhelming with the entire Steamworks process, quite a few steps to research, go through, experiment with. Everything from marketing, to graphics design, pitching, translations, and what else. It's truly a big step in the life of a small indiegame team! 

A big shoutout to everyone who has helped me during this process. Thanks to my graphics designer, language translators, playtesters, and all amazing fans and friends for BELIEVING IN ME, I would never be able to do this without you!

A big credits post for all these amazing people will come later!

Thanks alot!
